audio.collabOverlapBadgeHint: How much volume rises and falls together (stage-1 signal) — actual muting also factors in the waveform check next to it
audio.collabWaveformUnavailableHint: This channel can't use the audio optimization worklet (older browser, etc.), so it's judged by volume timing alone, without a waveform check
audio.collabWaveformPendingHint: No waveform comparison result yet, so this channel won't be muted until it's confirmed
audio.collabNoChannels: You need at least 2 channels to create a collab group.
audio.collabNoGroups: Group channels broadcasting together — when audio overlaps, only the leader stays audible and the rest mute automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.uiLanguageHint: Changes the language shown on screen.
settings.minViewersHint: Live channels below this viewer count are hidden from search results.
settings.debugModeHint: Shows dB waveforms and collab analysis (per-lag correlation, waveform similarity) in the per-channel audio panel.
settings.audioHint: Max volume per channel in Grid/Sub mode. In Grid, loud channels auto-lower to match the group's quietest one. Among Subs, channels normalize toward the group's average — quiet ones get boosted and loud ones lowered — but never above this max. Near-silent channels are excluded.
settings.experimentalHint: Turn on to see and apply the experiments below.
settings.audioOptimizationHint: Auto-levels channel loudness within each group. May not match the player's shown volume — use the extension's own settings instead.
settings.dynamicsCompressorHint: Smooths a broadcast's own volume swings (screams, whispers) before comparing loudness across channels.
settings.collabSettingHint: Adds a Collab Settings section below the per-channel audio panel. When channels grouped as a collab have overlapping audio, only the leader channel stays audible and the rest mute automatically.
settings.collabVadHint: Compares overlap only during segments where the leader is actually speaking, for better accuracy. Downloads about 15MB the first time it's used, and increases CPU usage (runs on a dedicated background thread, so the screen won't freeze).
settings.collabVadStatusLoading: Loading the AI voice detection model... (first time only, up to a few tens of seconds)
settings.collabVadStatusUnavailable: AI voice detection is unavailable; falling back to the previous method.
settings.noticeStructure: May not work correctly if a platform changes its structure.
settings.noticeYoutubeTag: YouTube does not support tag search.
settings.noticeKoreanSearch: CHZZK / SOOP only support search in Korean.
